name: BLEND translator
description: TMGMT translator plugin for the BLEND (formerly One Hour Translation) human translation service.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 BLEND Translation API for the Translation Management Tool (TMGMT) module allows you to easily access professional translations directly from your Drupal installation. This integration is provided by BLEND, a leading localization platform that combines the power of AI-driven technologies and a global community of language experts. 

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Fast, high quality translation of your website, performed by the BLEND global network of +25K professional linguists, empowered by latest AI and NMT technologies 
 Automatic process for translation projects directly from the Drupal platform 
 Highest standards of quality assurance by our team of language leaders and reviewers 
 Supporting a over 120 languages, in various fields of expertise (see  full list of supported languages ) 
 24/7 customer support to ensure high satisfaction 
 BLEND translation plugin support Drupal 7, Drupal 8, Drupal 9 and Drupal 10. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires TMGMT ( http://drupal.org/project/tmgmt ) module

to be installed. Also you will need to enter the API keys which you get by registering to BLEND: https://app.getblend.com/auth/register 

 Back to top
